card.name: During/until after advice on contraception
card.fires_on: The word "during" (or "until") right after a counseling instruction such as using effective contraception, not breastfeeding, or not driving, in patient-counseling sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Contraception advice
modes.description: "during" after advice to use effective contraception, before "treatment with" a drug name.
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception<< during>> treatment with ORSERDU and for

modes.label: Breastfeeding advice
modes.description: "during" after a statement that breastfeeding is not recommended.
modes.example: advise patients that breastfeeding is not recommended<< during>> treatment with clorazepate dip

modes.label: Driving advice
modes.description: "until" after advice not to drive or operate heavy machinery.
modes.example: Advise patients not to drive or operate heavy machinery<< until>> the effects of concomitant use of
